subject: MAP: Acme — performance plan and embedding+reranker bench summary
messages:
From: Jordan Lee <jordan@acme.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Next steps on perf evaluation for embeddings + reranker

Ben — thanks for the quick demo today. The team wants a short mutual action plan (MAP) that lays out the performance gates we need to hit during pilot: latency SLOs for embeddings API, reranker tail latency, and throughput under concurrent search traffic.

High level asks from Acme:
- TTFT for single-request embeddings <= 30ms median, p95 < 120ms
- Reranker end-to-end p95 (per query across topK=50) < 400ms at concurrency 8
- Sustained throughput for embeddings of ~1.2k qps during peak batch windows

Can you put together a plan and share bench results you run against the exact model versions? Also share any config (batching, cache) we should lock for pilot.

— Jordan
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-21T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Next steps on perf evaluation for embeddings + reranker

Jordan — appreciated the clear requirements. I attached a draft MAP and a short bench plan. Quick summary of what we'll deliver by next Wednesday:

- Controlled benchmark results for embeddings and reranker (median, p50/p95/p99, TTFT, throughput at 3 concurrency points)
- Workload and config snapshots (batch sizes, KV cache settings, quantization profiles used)
- Actionable knobs for pilot to meet your SLOs and fallbacks if we see regressions

Attached: mutual-action-plan-acme.xlsx (MAP draft) and bench plan.

Proposed MAP milestones (draft):
- 2026-02-26: Redwood runs benchmarks and shares raw results
- 2026-03-03: Acme review and define pilot config
- 2026-03-12: Pilot signoff (SLA/go-live decision)

Looping Marissa to coordinate the bench run and Monica to own the MAP updates after we get results.

Best,
Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: mutual-action-plan-acme.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-24T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Bench run scheduling + infra snapshot for Acme MAP

Ben / Monica — scheduling the bench run for tomorrow (Feb 25) morning. Notes for the run:
- Models: embedding-v2.1 (float16, q8_0), reranker-v1.4 (int8 quantized candidate scorer)
- Hardware: 4xA100 per node; 2 nodes reserved (isolated test VLAN)
- Workloads:
  * Embeddings: mix of 16k short queries (avg len 24 tokens) and 4k long queries (avg 128 tokens)
  * Reranker: candidate pool size 100, topK=50 scoring path; simulate 8, 16 concurrent query streams
- Metrics to capture: TTFT, latency p50/p95/p99, throughput (qps), tokens/sec, GPU util, mem util, tail GC events

Attachments will include CSV exports and PDF load-report. Monica — can you capture the config yaml and include kernel/runtime flags?

Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: embedding-bench-20260225.csv (text/csv)]
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-25T16:44:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Bench run results (raw)

Forwarding raw outputs from today's runs. Summary toplines are below; raw CSV and perf graphs attached.

-- Forwarded message --
From: infra-bench@redwood.ai (automation)
To: monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-02-25T15:58:00-08:00
Subject: Bench job ACME-2026-02-25 completed

Job summary (embeddings):
- Model: embedding-v2.1 (fp16, q8_0)
- Single-request TTFT (client->first-token): median 22ms, p95 58ms, p99 120ms
- Throughput sustained: 1,470 qps (30s window) at concurrency 32 with batching enabled (max batch 64, avg 28)
- GPU util (avg): 65% across A100s; memory headroom ~18%

Job summary (reranker):
- Model: reranker-v1.4 (int8 candidate scorer path)
- Single-query p50: 48ms; p95: 210ms; p99: 360ms (topK=50, end-to-end including embedding fetch)
- Throughput: 320 qps end-to-end at concurrency 8 (batching disabled for re-ranking path), throughput drops ~18% at concurrency 16 with tail latency increasing to p95 ~420ms
- Observations: KV cache hit-rate for repeated contexts was >92% and gave ~12% improvement in mean latency for embeddings; reranker is more sensitive to concurrency due to memory bandwidth on NVLink

Attachments: reranker-load-report-20260225.pdf, embedding-bench-20260225.csv

Monica
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan@acme.com>, Rajiv Patel <rajiv@datasift.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-26T10:22:00-08:00
Subject: Acme MAP — bench summary and recommended pilot config (Feb 25 run)

Jordan / Rajiv — thanks for the patience. Attached is a concise summary and the MAP updated with the bench outputs. TL;DR: we hit your core targets for embeddings and we have a safe config to try in pilot for reranker. Key items:

Embeddings (embedding-v2.1):
- TTFT: median 22ms (meets <=30ms), p95 58ms (meets <120ms)
- Sustained throughput: 1,470 qps at concurrency 32 (above your target ~1.2k qps)
- Notes: use batching (max_batch=64, dynamic batching enabled) and prefix KV caching enabled for repeated embeddings workloads

Reranker (reranker-v1.4):
- End-to-end p95: 210ms at concurrency 8 (meets your 400ms goal)
- Warning: p95 increases to ~420ms at concurrency 16; recommend soft cap at concurrency 12 for pilot or enable an async fallback to a cheaper reranker variant when queue depth grows

Recommended pilot config (to lock in MAP):
- Model pins: embedding-v2.1@sha256:abc123, reranker-v1.4@sha256:def456
- Embedding route: batching (max 64), KV cache TTL 10m, region us-west-2
- Reranker route: concurrency ceiling 12 with monitored auto-fallback to reranker-lite@v1.0 when 95th > 350ms for 30s window

Next steps / MAP milestones:
- 2026-03-03: Acme to review and confirm pilot config (who: Jordan, Rajiv)
- 2026-03-12: Pilot signoff / go/no-go (internal exec review)
- 2026-04-01: Production rollout target (depends on pilot outcome)

I attached the updated MAP and the two bench artifacts. Let us know if you want a short readout call (15–20m) to walk the numbers.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachments: mutual-action-plan-acme.xlsx, reranker-load-report-20260225.pdf, embedding-bench-20260225.csv]
From: Jordan Lee <jordan@acme.com>

Cc: Rajiv Patel <rajiv@datasift.com>
Date: 2026-02-26T17:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Acme MAP — bench summary and recommended pilot config (Feb 25 run)

- We'll take the pilot config and confirm by Mar 3. Rajiv will own the config review.
- Please include a quick checklist for the pilot run (who runs smoke tests, what alerts to set, runbook for fallback to reranker-lite).

If you can send a 15-minute sync early next week to walk the MAP and the runbook, we'll lock dates.

— Jordan
